title: VRUN: Vaults of Obsolete Code for MS-DOS
description: The DOS port of the Game Boy game (project vrun-voc): the same physics and maps (src/phys, src/maps), a VGA picture, OPL2 music and effects (the effects on the PC speaker without an FM chip). Built with Open Watcom 2.0 + DOS/32A (C:\BrokenNes-tools\dos, env.ps1) in its live workspace PROJECTS/VRUN_VOC_DOS_dev (its own git, remote brokendev). It runs on BrokenNes's x86 PC: the .exe boots on a FreeDOS disk made for it.

toolchain: Open Watcom 2.0 (wcl386, DOS/32A) in C:\BrokenNes-tools\dos (env.ps1); not pinned in toolchains.json

steps.name: build
steps.note: build.ps1 -Target game: wcl386 with DOS/32A bound in -> build/VRUNVOC.EXE.

run.note: BrokenNes desktop: open VRUNVOC.EXE as the x86 PC. Pad on the x86: the arrows, A = Ctrl, B = Alt, Start = Enter (PcSession.KeyFor); the game reads Ctrl / Space as A, Alt as B, Enter as Start.

scenarios.why: FreeDOS boots the game, the title plays music, A on the title starts RUN and the first map is drawn

knownIssues: No symbols: the Watcom map is not read by BrokenDev, so expect.memory needs physical addresses (domain mem).
No other emulator in BrokenDev runs DOS (DOSBox-X is the game repo's own tests/), so there is no compat section.
